module: "Location" class of a sites set (*.sites.json file): a named map point with a position, a radius and a color. Used to mark places (start, finish, point of interest) in scenarios, missions and traffic. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/sites/location')(sites, name, forceId).
usage:
local loc = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/sites/location')(sitesObj, 'Garage')
loc:set(vec3(0,0,0), 8)
local info = loc:findClosestRoadInfo()
notes: Default radius 5 m; default drawMode 'faded'; default sortOrder 999999.
onDeserialized sets the radius via set(...) then rewrites it with "data.radius or 5"; if data.radius is nil, set() first sets radius to nil before the correction.
findClosestRoadInfo requires the global map module (returns nil otherwise).

C.desc: Location object. Fields: sites, id, name, color (vec3), pos (vec3), radius, customFields (gameplay/util/customFields).

init.desc: Constructor called by the module. Takes a unique identifier from the sites object if forceId is absent, default name "Location <id>".

onSerialize.desc: Returns a serializable table (name, pos, radius, color, oldId, customFields).

onDeserialized.desc: Restores name, color, position, radius and custom fields from a serialized table.

set.desc: Sets the position and radius of the location.

drawDebug.desc: Draws a debug sphere (and the name if the mode is not 'faded'). In 'highlight' mode, also draws the closest road. Nothing beyond the view distance (300 m, or the editor preference).

findClosestRoadInfo.desc: Looks for the closest road segment via map.findClosestRoad and returns the point projected onto that segment, with the interpolated radius. Nodes a and b are swapped so that a is the closest.

returns.desc: {name_a, name_b, a, b, distance, pos, radius} or nil if no road / map missing.
